name: openrouter-image-gen
tagline_zh: 不用另配绘图服务，文本生图、图生图改稿都走 OpenRouter 一个 key。像素画、精灵图。
tagline_en: Skip extra image APIs—text-to-image and image edits both use one OpenRouter key. Pixel art, sprites, stickers.
desc_en: Generate raster / pixel-art images with OpenRouter's image models via the `/api/v1/images/generations` endpoint, and optionally edit an existing image via `/api/v1/images/edits`. Use when the user wants to create or transform an image through OpenRouter (text-to-image, image-to-image edits, spritesheet concepts) and the result should be written to disk as a PNG. why_zh: 把生成和编辑统一到 OpenRouter 的 images 端点，少一套鉴权、少一类账单。
why_en: Unifies generation and editing under OpenRouter's images endpoint—one auth, one bill. Writes PNGs straight to disk, skipping.
limit_zh: 只认 OpenRouter 的 images/generations 与 edits 两个端点；不接本地模型。
limit_en: Only OpenRouter images/generations & edits endpoints; no local models, no GIF/WebP, output is PNG-only. If your key lacks image-model access, calls.
title_en: OpenRouter image gen & edit, PNG straight to disk
